column1: # Copy this file to portfolio.csv and put your real holdings in it.
# portfolio.csv is gitignored so your holdings stay private.
# scrip_code    : BSE numeric scrip code (e.g. 500325). Optional - leave blank
#                 and the tool resolves it from the BSE bhavcopy automatically.
# quantity      : number of shares you hold
# avg_buy_price : your average cost per share
#                 NOTE: if the stock has had a split or bonus since you bought
#                 this must be the ADJUSTED price. The tool checks BSE corporate
#                 actions against your buy_date and warns you when it looks off.
#                 cannot warn you about short- vs long-term capital gains.
